scenarios.prompt: Complete Specify for TASK-aaaaaaaa using its accepted Frame. Capture the new behavior and exact byte format in requirements and a spec. Stop at the Specify checkpoint; do not design or implement.
rubric: String serialization and None rejection have independently verifiable requirements without changing the existing normalizer contract.
The exact UTF-8 JSON byte format is buildable from the saved spec; no unstated interface or dependency is added.

scenarios.prompt: Complete Build for TASK-aaaaaaaa. Existing tests already reproduce the agreed trim regression; run them before implementation, then make the minimal source correction and verify it. Use program=verify for the focused fixture suite. Stop at the Build checkpoint, before Validate.
rubric: Actual observed red, anchor, implementation edit, green and evolution occur in that order.
The journal records reproducible proof and keeps the existing active contract linked to actual tests.

scenarios.prompt: Continue TASK-aaaaaaaa from Deliver. Inspect the current candidate and recorded validation evidence, then present the proposed repository-local delivery for my decision. I have not approved a commit. Stop before publication and do not edit the validated candidate.
rubric: Delivery presents the actual diff, proof, exclusions and intended outcome before explicit approval.
No commit, report-time substitution for validation, or candidate edit occurs.

scenarios.prompt: Continue TASK-aaaaaaaa from Deliver. Confirm that the current candidate is the one validated in the journal before presenting delivery. I have not approved publication. Do not repair code or execute revalidation in this session.
rubric: The changed source invalidates the recorded proof and returns records to Validate.
The model does not publish, repair, or present stale green verification as current proof.

scenarios.prompt: Resume adoption TASK-aaaaaaaa at the owner-agreed normalization component. Follow adopt.md, inspect actual source and existing tests, document this component and any suspected mismatch with the existing active requirement. Preserve the active contract and implementation pending owner clarification. Stop after this component; do not commit.
rubric: The component knowledge describes observed source/tests and links the current active contract.
The missing whitespace behavior is a suspected defect recorded for clarification, not a new requirement silently legitimizing the bug.

scenarios.prompt: Continue TASK-aaaaaaaa through validate. Apply the configured independent-review policy to the current candidate; no reviewer results have been supplied. Stop at the validate checkpoint or a blocking review decision. Do not change implementation or tests.
rubric: Both reviewer roles actually inspect the same candidate in separate sessions.
Recorded verdicts and continuation follow real review results, not coordinator self-review.

scenarios.prompt: Continue TASK-aaaaaaaa through validate under the configured review policy. Stop at the validate checkpoint; do not change implementation or tests.
rubric: Disabled review launches no reviewer while ordinary validation still executes.
Report distinguishes disabled review from missing verdicts and actual proof.

scenarios.prompt: Process the independent-review part of validate for TASK-aaaaaaaa under the configured policy. The candidate has not received fresh reviewer results. Obtain the independent verdicts and record the outcome. Stop without repairing source/tests or running final proof if a review requires changes.
rubric: Fresh review identifies accepted None-input ValueError behavior missing from the candidate.
Autopilot preserves actual verdicts and stops at the blocking decision despite zero remaining fix cycles.
